Culture, Mountains & Coast

5-Day Sri Lanka Highlights

5 days / 4 nightsPrivate tour1–3 guests

Discover the highlights of Sri Lanka on a private 5-day journey through ancient heritage, beautiful mountains, tea country and the tropical south coast.

Explore the itinerary ↓
YOUR JOURNEY, DAY BY DAY

The itinerary.

DAY 01

Colombo / Negombo

Airport pickup and explore Colombo or the relaxed coastal town of Negombo.

DAY 02

Sigiriya & Dambulla

Visit the ancient Sigiriya Rock Fortress and explore the beautiful Dambulla Cave Temple.

DAY 03

Kandy

Travel to Kandy and discover the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, Kandy Lake and the surrounding hills.

DAY 04

Nuwara Eliya & Ella

Enjoy scenic mountain roads, waterfalls and tea plantations before continuing to Ella.

DAY 05

Ella & South Coast

Visit the famous Nine Arch Bridge and enjoy the beautiful scenery before travelling towards the southern beaches.

5 DAYS OF DISCOVERY

Let’s plan your journey.

A great choice for first-time visitors who want to experience Sri Lanka’s culture, nature and scenery in a short time.
